def: likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication, equity

occurrences.text: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
